snippet.title: There are No Ghosts at the Grand - Early Access Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

You inherit a crumbling hotel in a British seaside town and have to restore it to its former glory. It's a renovation adventure from Friday Sundae, with musical numbers and a mystery behind the hotel's very insistent claim that it has no ghosts.
